articles.title: I’m a pro chef. Here is everything I use for stress-free Thanksgiving turkey prep
articles.description: Skip the stress with my foolproof guide to getting Thanksgiving turkey on the table The Anyday glass food containers transformed how I store leftovers Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things Thanksgiving’s piece de resistance, the turkey, is a special type of stressor. It is hard to get right – that balance of juicy breast meat, crispy skin, and tender pull-apart legs and wings. But here’s what the food magazines and TV shows may not tell you: the platonic ideal of a whole roast turkey is impossible. A moist breast inhibits skin crispiness; legs cooked to succulence means the breast is cooked to dryness. So let that be a source of relief. If a traditional roast turkey is impossible to perfect, then just control what you can. As a culinary arts and science professor, I spend my days thinking about how to make food not only tastier but smarter.
